docs.author: Dr. Alan Whitcombe
sentences: Patient is a 33-year-old woman with low back pain for about four months.
No fever, weight loss, saddle numbness or cancer history.
Lumbar X-rays on 2026-06-23 showed mild degenerative change.
Symptoms persist after more than two months of physical therapy and daily naproxen.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.

payer_letter: Harborline Medicare Advantage has reviewed claim A-1059 for MRI of the lumbar spine. Coverage requires documentation of a prior lumbar spine X-ray together with at least six weeks of conservative treatment, or a red flag condition. The records submitted do not document a prior lumbar spine X-ray. You may request reconsideration within 60 days of this notice.
